verdict.rationale: Spline's docs strongly evidence advanced prototyping behavior: states/events/actions interaction model, variables and real-time API, webhooks for event-driven reactions, animation, multi-scene transitions, physics, and even code/HTML embedding for custom logic — all built to make prototypes feel like real products. Missing for 10: independent hands-on validation of complex behavior chains (scroll-driven effects specifically) and no dedicated 'scroll trigger' doc beyond general events/actions system.
